notes.title: Devlog 01 - Expeditions and transportation system
notes.content: [h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44395397/325e095dcaaa1bc03377a21d8beb41a736ec96e8.png"][/img][/h1][h1]We’re excited to announce the start of a devlog series for [b]Dragonscale Monastery[/b]! [/h1][p]We’ll be sharing a behind-the-scenes look at our work on this exciting game. From the creative process and the challenges we face, to everything that goes into bringing the project to life — each episode will be packed with details about the game’s mechanics and artistic vision.[/p][p]We want you to be part of this journey, so stay with us and follow every step of [b]Dragonscale Monastery’s[/b] development! 🔥🐉[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="bLIcfQc1WeA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p]
